description: Progressive MSA followed by MUSCLE-style tree-dependent restricted-partitioning refinement (Edgar 2004, stage 3): each guide-tree edge splits the alignment into two profiles that are re-aligned and kept only if the sum-of-pairs score strictly improves; repeated until convergence or maxIterations passes. Never scores below multiple_align_progressive. Linear gap model (gapOpen ignored).

sequences.description: DNA sequences to align (at least one).

gapExtend.description: Gap penalty charged per gap position.

maxIterations.description: Upper bound on full refinement passes (>= 1).

alignedSequences.description: The aligned rows of the MSA.

consensus.description: Majority-vote consensus of the aligned rows (gaps vote; a nucleotide beats a gap on ties).

totalScore.description: Column sum-of-pairs score of the MSA (match/mismatch from the matrix, residue-gap = gapExtend, gap-gap = 0).
